Bounds.description: The inclusive bounds of a setting's value.

Change.description: One entry of the change log.

state.description: The subject after the change, as its own route reads it; `null` once removed.

Code.description: Every stable machine code the core answers with; the SPA maps each to text (ADR 11).

code.description: A stable machine code, such as `clock.unsynced`.

secrets.description: The names of the secrets set; their values are never read back.
Credentials by name: a value sets one, `null` removes it, an absent name is kept.

ConnectionDraft.description: A connection as the admin enters it.

Datasheet.description: A PV module model's datasheet values.

powerCoefficient.description: Of Pmax, Voc and Isc, in %/K.

vmp.description: Volts and amperes at the maximum power point.

id.description: Stable; never reused. The device id of its history.

DeviceDraft.description: Where a device sits and how it is read.

profile.description: The profile's id, such as `deye-sg05lp3`; fixed once the device is added.

unit.description: The Modbus unit id: the device address behind the connection.

writes.description: Whether settings may be written (ADR 7); off when left out.

estimated.description:
Series computed from others, not measured, such as `pv.string.power[3]` of a string
in parallel (ADR 17).

settings.description: What its profile lets the core write, in the profile's order.

writes.description: Whether the admin switched its writes on (ADR 7).

after.description: The value read back; `null` when nothing was written or it could not be read.

before.description:
The value read before writing; `null` when it could not be read or the setting is
write-only.

failedStep.description: The recipe step that failed, counted from 1.

issued.description: When the value was issued, RFC 3339, UTC.

Forecasts.description: One series' forecasts, at most 1,500 points.

Frame.description: Values by device id, then by series name, such as `pv.mppt.power[2]`.

History.description: Time-weighted means of one series over a range, at the tier the server picked.

points.description: In time order; a gap has no point.

IndexProblem.description: Why an index could not be read.

Location.description: The plant's location in degrees, north and east positive.

Offer.description: One entry of an index and what became of it.

mean.description: The value weighted by the time it held between `start` and `end`.

code.description: A stable machine code, such as `auth.required`.

PvString.description: Modules in series on one plane; strings on one MPPT input are in parallel.

Reach.description: How the core reaches an endpoint, without its secrets.

Report.description: An index and the outcome of its last check.

checked.description: Whether it was checked since the core started.

Schemas.description: An inclusive range of profile schemas.

SettingSupport.description: A setting a device's profile declares (ADR 5, 7).

oneOf.description: The bounds of a value; absent when `values` lists them.

step.description: A value is a whole number of steps.

values.description: The only values it takes, when the profile enumerates them.

value.description: In the setting's unit, a whole number of its steps.

Status.description: What became of one entry of an index.

id.description: A string kept from an earlier version; absent for a new string.

Support.description:
What this core supports (ADR 9). The schemas and capabilities are the profile crate's table,
the one its WASM build reports.

capabilities.description: The bindings, decoders and computed quantities a profile may require.

devices.description: By device id, what the layout in force says of its series.

schema.description: The profile schemas this core loads.

Tier.description:
`raw` intervals between change points, UTC-aligned buckets of them, or `hour` (UTC) or
`day` (plant-local) rollups.

Transport.description: The wire framing on a connection's endpoint.

Wiring.description: Where a string sits and what it is made of.

input.description: The MPPT input, from 1, as the `pv.mppt.*` index.

optimized.description: How many of its modules have an optimizer.

post.summary: Adds a connection: an endpoint and its credentials.

delete.summary: Removes a connection no device uses.

put.summary: Changes a connection; its devices are polled through it at once.

post.summary: Adds a device behind a connection and starts polling it.

delete.summary: Removes a device and stops polling it; its history stays under its id.

put.summary: Changes a device's name, connection or unit id; its profile is fixed.

parameters.description: The instant after the last target, RFC 3339.
parameters.name: to

parameters.description: Only issues before this instant, RFC 3339; the latest issue when absent.
parameters.name: issuedBefore

parameters.description: The instant after the last, RFC 3339.
parameters.name: to

put.summary:
Writes a setting through the one funnel (ADR 7) and answers the attempt as the write log keeps
it. A refusal never reaches the device.

get.summary: The layout in force at an instant.

put.summary: Changes the layout from an instant on; new strings get fresh ids.

get.summary:
Server-sent events: a `snapshot` of every value on connect, then a `delta` per second in
which a value changed. There is no replay: a client that falls behind is disconnected and
reconnects to a fresh snapshot.

put.summary: Sets the plant's location, stored to 0.01°; the weather and solar forecasts follow at once.

204.description: Signed in; the cookie is set

post.summary: Signs the admin in to a session cookie.
Adds a module type; the admin enters its datasheet, there is no catalogue.

get.summary: The official profile index, then each one the admin added, with the outcome of its last check.

post.summary:
Adds a profile index and fetches it at once; its profiles load as community profiles unless
signed by the profile key.
Checks every index for updates: the only fetch besides adding an index, never on a timer.

get.summary: Whether the request carries a live session.

post.summary: The first run sets the admin password; there is no registration.
